properties.text:
HELM LAB. Most people want 'Helm 3 - Make your own axis' instead: it does all of this in one node.

This is the manual way to build an idea from two recordings.
1) Run the 'Record activations' graph twice (see krea2_helm_collect): once with the name 'pos' and your 'with the idea' prompt, once with the name 'neg' and your 'without the idea' prompt.
2) Type those two names here and give the new axis a name.
3) Run. The axis is saved in ComfyUI/user/steer/ and can be used by Apply axis.
This node needs no model. The preview shows the result.
